supersedes.reason: Four model-generated attempts were made on the task under v12. Post-run audit reproduced candidate reads of grader tests and installed MLX-LM implementation artifacts, and showed pytest output could be forged; all historical v14 grades are invalid.
supersedes.prior_outcomes_or_model_exposure: Attempts 1 and 2 produced no usable source diff; attempts 3 and 4 produced source diffs, with two historical TEST_FAIL records under the invalid grader. No independent grades are valid, and no optimizer update occurred.

grader.success: All three pinned model cases load from the candidate source, produce finite logits matching a fresh trusted-baseline forward pass, produce finite nonzero selected-expert and router gradients, and contain only the exact pinned route-index stop-gradient AST edit. The upstream pytest test is not imported or executed; its hash and selectors are retained for provenance only.

calibration.wrong_mutant_description: Apply the pinned repair to the two Granite MoE files and retain the LFM2 MoE baseline; the LFM2 source contract must reject it.
calibration.note: Calibration on this task is permanently ineligible after candidate/model exposure; these expectations are for a fresh, independently identified task only.

isolation.writable_paths: fresh per-attempt scratch directory and narrowly scoped Metal compiler caches only
isolation.candidate_agent_tool_access_to_grader: denied; grader files are absent from the task workspace and are not allowlisted for agent read tools
isolation.candidate_agent_receives_grader_output: only after its trajectory has completed and is not fed back during this pilot
isolation.filesystem_root_read: file-read-data permission on the literal root directory only; no recursive root subpath permission
isolation.python_base_runtime: sys.base_prefix is allowlisted for read-only file access; no write permission
isolation.pytest_configuration: The pinned trusted test is copied into the read-only grader source root beside trusted model code. Pytest uses that root as its config and confcutdir; it receives metadata-only access to the one parent directory needed by pytest hook discovery, with no directory listing or file data access there.
isolation.metal_gpu: Only AGXDeviceUserClient and IOSurfaceRootUserClient iokit-open classes and com.apple.MTLCompilerService global/XPC lookup are allowed; verified with a tiny MLX GPU operation. Network remains denied.
isolation.entropy_device: /dev/urandom is readable by exact literal path to support transitive native test dependencies; no broader /dev access is granted.
isolation.candidate_worker: Hash-pinned evaluator/candidate_worker.py runs in a separate process; candidate source and trusted baseline source are copied into separate read-only roots.
isolation.upstream_test_execution: not executed; pinned test hash/selectors are provenance only
isolation.protected_path_denials: Task/grader files, original candidate workspace and its .git, trusted baseline, trusted known-fix source, reference source, installed MLX-LM source/bytecode/metadata/archive locations are denied after broad read allows.
isolation.worker_output: Strict single-JSON schema with request nonce; no pytest text or count parser; candidate never receives baseline reference outputs.

exposure.researcher_source_qualification: Four model-generated v14 attempts occurred before this correction: two yielded no usable source diff, and two yielded source edits that were historically marked TEST_FAIL by an invalid grader. The historical grades are not independent or valid. The corrected grader and fresh-task calibration have not been run.
exposure.related_exposure: A separate MLX-LM Development diagnostic used the same upstream baseline revision but targeted mlx_lm/generate.py. This Train task concerns MoE backward routing in three different files. Cross-task source-snapshot exposure is disclosed; pretraining exposure is unknown.
